'''Bacrana''' was the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] at the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

==History==
Bacrana had its capital at [[Amma]], which was the site of a strong [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell following the decisive [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in charge, a man named [[Lesan Ramier]], swiftly put down a [[Amma protest|civilian insurrection]] and placed Amma under martial law. The Imperials managed to capture an important Rebel agent on Bacrana, though the agent was eventually rescued from detention by three Rebel squads.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] developed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] &mdash; along with [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]] and [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] &mdash; into a staging area for transport fleets and military units. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] abandoned the planet the same year, after the [[Battle of Druckenwell (Galactic Civil War)|liberation of Druckenwell]]. The planet joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />
